All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }`. Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM. Always request on station init, release in cleanup. Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup. Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`). Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room). Always use `bun test -- --run` to disable watch mode (prevents agent bash timeout).

bun run dev
bun run dev:https
bun run build
bun run test -- --run
bun run preview
bun run dev:https -- --host <REDACTED_IP>
